mapper.select: select d.id as deptId, d.name as deptName, count(r.id) as total, ifnull(sum(case when r.read_flag = 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as unread, ifnull(round(sum(case when r.read_flag = 0 then 1 else 0 end) / nullif(count(r.id), 0) * 100, 2), 0) as rate from ann_receipt r left join sys_dept d on d.id = r.dept_id where r.announcement_id = #{announcementId} group by r.dept_id, d.id, d.name order by unread desc, total desc
select ifnull(count(1), 0) from ann_receipt r where r.announcement_id = #{announcementId} and r.read_flag = 0
